# Giant Ancestry: Hill's Tumble (`traits:giant-ancestry-hills-tumble`)
**Species:** [Goliath](../species/goliath.md) | **Subspecies:** [Giant Ancestry: Hill's Tumble](../subspecies/giant-ancestry-hills-tumble.md)

When you hit a Large or smaller creature with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can give that target the Prone condition.
